mandatoryCriteria: Workbook status labels such as constructor/toString/__proto__ never access inherited mapping properties, corrupt target IDs or produce500. Explicit own mappings still work with normal target authorization and preview revision checks.

Additive mappingEntries [{sourceStatus,columnId}] allows reserved text labels without relying on JavaScript object keys; the older mappings record stays supported. Reject ambiguous duplicate mapping labels.
Actual import status includes initiating actor/time and committed actor/time from persisted source facts, not the current reader. Legacy absent commit facts stay unknown; no identity is invented.
Provenance PersonDisplay has no email/private session fields, remains attributable for removed actors and is available only through current Owner/Manager import/board access.

Receipt lookup is indexed/bounded; committed batch/card links and existing retention cleanup remain correct. New fields are additive for older clients/fixtures; mounted real responses always populate available source facts.
Real mounted PostgreSQL before/after tests and final independent source review are required; UI receipt display remains a separate handoff.
Import GET validates limit1..100 and canonical nonnegative row-number cursor before SQL; malformed values return422, never silently discard paging controls.

Genuine supplied-template XML self-closing empty cells/rows/shared strings cannot consume a later element or silently drop fields. Blank Assignees followed by unknown Status must block commit and require mapping.
